title: Renders read as 'late teens / early twenties' — persona age is undefined, and the reference workflow carried juvenile-adjacent tokens
evidence: Independent vision reads of three production renders all returned a youthful age: gen-1789832734 -> 'a young girl, likely a teenager'; gen-1789833673 -> 'late teens or early twenties'; gen-1789834527 -> 'late teens or early twenties'. The read is stable BEFORE and AFTER the checkpoint change (cyberrealisticpony -> Pornmaster), so it comes from the persona preset / identity LoRA, not the base model. Contributing inputs: the workflow preset carries 'petite face, small nose' (node 88), and the reference pipeline-20 preset additionally carried 'underbooba, underboobs' alongside the identity tokens (sarah1a3, s1_dram). The images themselves are fully dressed and pass the NSFW gate comfortably (0.0004-0.0722 against ~0.5), so this is NOT a gate failure -- it is an audience-fit and platform-risk question for a public Instagram account.
